title: Lake Balkhash water balance
model: Monthly bucket model: dV = Q_in + (P − k_E·ET0)·A(h) − G

sources.hypsometry: Tursunov, Madibekov & Kulebaev, "Present morphometrical parameters of Balkhash lake", Uchenye Zapiski RSHU 34 (2014), Table 1 — bathymetric survey 2011–2013
sources.levels: Ivkina, "Water level variations on the Balkash Lake in the modern period", Hydrometeorology and Ecology 3 (2022), doi:10.54668/2789-6323-2022-106-3-6-13
sources.balance: Alimkulov et al., "Long-Term Water Level Projections for Lake Balkhash Using Scenario-Based Water Balance Modeling", Water 17 (2025) 2021, doi:10.3390/w17132021, Tables 3–5
sources.climate: ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo historical weather API (precipitation_sum, et0_fao_evapotranspiration)
